name: Palomares del Río (Spain)
description: Quartered green and white with a cross of yellow, blue and yellow stripes set towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Palomares del Río (a dove on green).
history: Municipal flag of Palomares del Río; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross of blue between yellow stripes set towards the hoist
